description: This header file declares the external API functions for a content filtering basic message component object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization functions.

methods.name: CfBasicMsgContentComponentCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the content filtering message content object with specified context handles.

methods.name: CfBasicMsgContentCOCreate
methods.description: Creates a new content object handle with specified context handles.

methods.name: CfBasicMsgContentCORemove
methods.description: Removes the content object identified by the handle.

methods.name: CfBasicMsgContentCOEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the content object.
